name: ObjectPool
signature: public class ObjectPool<T> where T : class

docs.summary: Generic object pool for reusing objects. Not thread safe, give each thread its own pool.

members.name: ObjectPool
members.signature: public ObjectPool(Func<T> objectGenerator, int initialSize = 0, int maxSize = 100)

params.objectGenerator: Function to create new objects when the pool is empty
params.initialSize: Initial number of objects to create
params.maxSize: Maximum number of objects to keep in the pool (0 for unlimited)

docs.summary: Gets an object from the pool, or creates a new one if the pool is empty
Returns an object to the pool
Gets the current count of objects in the pool
Clears all objects from the pool
